## Verifikation

- [ ] `npm run test:fast`

- [ ] Bei Paket-/Releaseänderungen: `npm run pack`, `npm run publish:dry-run`, `npm run test:npm-clean-install`, `npm run package:portable` und `npm run verify:portable-release`
